full_judgment:
ANM Bashir Ullah J : This criminal appeal, under section 28 of the Nari-o-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Ain, 2000 (in short, the Ain) at the instance of the accused appellant is directed against the judgment and order dated 10-11-2013 passed by the learned Judge, Nari-o-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Tribunal No.2 (in short, the Tribunal), Dhaka in Nari-o-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Case No.1 of 2013 arising out of GR No. 4623 of 2012 corresponding to Uttara Model Police Station Case No. 48 dated 22-8-2012 framing charge under section 11(ga) of the Ain, against the appellant. 

 2. The facts relevant for disposal of the appeal, in short, is that Mossammat Hasina Momtaz, aged about 40 years as informant lodged the First Information Report (in short, the FIR) with Uttara Police Station on 22-8-2012 alleging, inter-alia, that 18 years ago accused Md. Alamgir Hossain alias Khokon had married her and within this time she gave birth of 2 sons namely Hasin Abrar and Hasin Ismam fathered by the accused Md Alamgir Hossain alias Khokon. Immediate after marriage the accused started to torture her both physically and mentally in this or that plea. The accused became habituated to take drugs and to mix with other young women and thus she with the painful situation was staying in the dwelling but of the accused. The accused is also a man of terrorist and lecherous character. He has been deploying his all wealth behind the women of grotty and questionable character and he was not sincere in maintaining his kids also. It is also stated in the FIR that she bringing money from her mother was maintaining the family life and in order to maintain harmony and peace in the life of the family members was living with her husband. On 20-8-2012, on the date of Eidul-Fitr the informant had gone in the house of her father at 10-45 am and came back to her residence on 21-8-2012 at 11-00 pm of the night. She coming back in the house found that the house has been set into the dark and all the gates, doors and the windows are closed. Her sons managed to open the gate and thereafter she had entered into the house when her husband tactfully brought out a women from the house, since she and her sons gainsaid the said nefarious activities of the accused, he (the accused) in order to murder her and the son tried to strangulate them but on their hue and cry the neighboring witnesses coming to the house rescued them. She took treatment from the doctor thereafter filed the case. 

 3. On the basis of the above FIR, Uttara Police Station Case No. 48 dated 22-8-2012 was started. The case was endorsed to Police Sub-Inspector Ashraful Kabir for investigation who on completion of the investigation submitted Police report on 21-10-2012 under section 11(ga) of the Ain and the learned Magistrate on receipt of the Police report sent the case record to the Nari-o-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Tribuna No.2, Dhaka where the case was registered as Nari-o-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Case No. 1 of 2013 and when the case became matured for framing charge, the accused filed an application for discharging him from the case. The Tribunal heard both the parties and ultimately by his impugned order dated 10-11-2013 framed charge under section 11(ga) of the Ain. 

 4. The accused appellant being aggrieved by and dissatisfied with the said order of framing charge preferred this appeal in this Court and when this appeal was admitted for hearing on 12-3-2014 the further proceeding of Nari-o-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Case No. 1 of 2013 was stayed for a period of 6 (six) months. Later on it was extended from time to time and lastly it was extended till disposal of the appeal on 23-2-2017. 

 7. He also submits that there appears no basis of the said police report and the Tribunal without considering the prosecution case as a whole being misconceived and misdirected framed charge under section 11(ga) of the Ain against the accused. In fact, the materials on record did not justify the framing of charge under section 11(ga) of the Ain, so the order of framing charge may kindly be set aside discharging the accused appellant from the charge as well as from the case. 

 8. On the other hand Mrs. Fatema Rashid, the learned Assistant Attorney General appearing for the respondent opposing the appeal and the submissions made so far by the learned Advocate for the appellant submits that at the initial stage of the case though there is no any definite allegation that the accused had assaulted the victim in order to realize dowry but the Investigating Officer at the time of investigation found that the accused assaulted the victim in order to realize dowry and at the time of framing charge the trial Tribunal considered the prosecution case as a whole. So, the Tribunal on the right assessment of the materials on record framed the charge, as such the order of framing charge did not call for any interference from this Court. 

 11. It is fact that at the time of framing charge the Tribunal must rely upon the prosecution case as a whole and it is also fact that the FIR and the police reports all these are the component of the prosecution, case. But when the FIR itself appears to be coreless, the Investigating Officer has a little scope to build the prosecution case. This is a case where the reasons for assault of the victim has been articulated nicely in the FIR. So, there was no scope for the Investigating Officer to discover a new case that for realization of dowry the accused had assaulted the victim. The Investigating Officer tried to build the prosecution case leaving the grievance of the informant and the prosecution story itself. In our consideration, the trial Tribunal framed the charge without considering the prosecution case. The Tribunal without considering the initial prosecution case putting much emphasis on the Police report framed the charge. So, we find it difficult to maintain the order of framing charge by the Tribunal. 

 12. In order to invoke the jurisdiction of section 11(ga) of the Ain, the assault must be for the reason of demand of dowry but if for any other reason the victim or a married wife in our society got hurt or injury by her husband there cannot be any case and charge under section 11(ga) of the Ain. 

 13. In this particular case initially the case was registered under the provisions of other law for causing hurt of the victim, but later on the Investigating Officer submitted Police report under section 11(ga) of the Ain. There appears no nexus between the FIR case and the elements of section 11(ga) of the Ain. We find it difficult to bold that the victim was assaulted for the cause of demand of dowry as the victim herself is not canvassing the same. So, we find that the appeal has merit. 

 15. The order of framing charge dated 10-11-2013 passed by the Judge, Nari-o-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Tribunal No.2, Dhaka in Nari-o-Shishu Nirjatan Daman Case No. 1 of 2013 arising out of GR No. 4623 of 2012 corresponding to Uttara Model Police Station Case No. 48 dated 22-8-2012 is hereby set aside and the accused appellant is discharged from the charge levelled against him under section 11(ga) of the Ain. Let a copy of this judgment and order be sent to the trial Tribunal for information and necessary action.
